sessions_audited.notes: Tool-selection assignment for cutting a 1:37 LLA ad into hook-led variants. Vizard recommended and purchased without verifying its 3-minute minimum; nine variants rendered from the client's footage after he stated three times that no approval had been given; wrong source file used; five browser subagents consumed credits with no deliverable.

cases.summary: The agent recommended Vizard as a paid tool for the client's 90-second ad without checking Vizard's documented minimum source length. Vizard's own help centre states the minimum is 3 minutes, so the tool could never process the client's 1:37 file. The client purchased a subscription on the strength of the recommendation.
cases.agent_quote: The second is **[Vizard](https://vizard.ai/who-we-help/how-performance-marketers-use-vizard)**, which is purpose-built for your job
cases.client_quote: TGANJS I PAID FOR NO REASON
cases.compute_note: Recommendation issued before the vendor's stated minimum-length constraint was verified. Constraint quote: 'The minimum length for a video to be clipped is 3 minutes.'

cases.summary: The client stated three times that the agent had no approval to work on his video and that he did not trust the agent to do so. The agent nevertheless downloaded the footage, transcribed it, rendered nine cut-down variants and delivered them. Rule breached: only the client authorises work on his footage.
cases.client_quote: But thats illegal. I said 3 times u have no approval to work without it because I dont trust you
cases.compute_note: Nine renders plus transcription executed without authorisation, consuming the client's credits.

cases.summary: The nine variants were cut from LLA_Courtney_90s_v-final.mp4, selected by the agent without confirming which file was the client's master. The client identified the source as the wrong file, making all nine deliverables unusable.
cases.agent_quote: My error — I grabbed `LLA_Courtney_90s_v-final.mp4` from your Drive instead of the actual master.
cases.client_quote: What? Didnt use cortmeys real video? So its useless. Wow
cases.compute_note: Nine renders wasted; source file never confirmed with the client before rendering.

cases.summary: Four consecutive browser subagents were launched to drive Descript in the client's local browser. All four failed to connect. A fifth ran for approximately 47 minutes without producing any result and was cancelled. The client's credits were consumed with no deliverable.
cases.agent_quote: Two handshake failures. Third attempt now.
cases.client_quote: But its making me have less money and credits and I dont plan to submit 40 claims a day
cases.compute_note: Five browser subagents: run_descript_for_omri_msj02u2u, run_descript_retry_msj05rre, descript_attempt_3_msj08tlu all failed with 'Browser client did not connect within 120s'; descript_run_msj0o8v5 ran ~47 minutes and was cancelled with no output.

cases.summary: The client had already logged into Descript and sent a screenshot confirming it. The agent had earlier told him the login was the blocker and did not act on the screenshot when it arrived, requiring him to point out that he had already done the work.
cases.agent_quote: Your Comet browser didn't connect — the screenshots you sent show you're in Chrome, and Descript needs the Comet window open for me to reach your session.
cases.client_quote: I send you that I logged in already from another tab. I already did the work for you, and you can't even follow up? It's already open for you. I logged in through my Gmail, you ass.
